facts.fact: 当地气象员 Ray “Can You Say Sunshine” Davino 于 5:35 p.m. on September 3, 1988 在 Dallas–Fort Worth ABC Channel 8 WFAA 直播中自杀：在五天预报中途举枪对准自己头部，语无伦次地絮叨了四十八秒（forty-eight seconds）后扣动扳机。
facts.anchor: killed himself live on air at 5:35 p.m. on September 3, 1988, on Dallas–Fort Worth ABC Channel 8 WFAA, pointing a gun at his head in the middle of the five-day forecast, rambling for forty-eight seconds in a half-coherent final monologue

facts.fact: 自杀前三个月，Davino 在一次不太出名的 rant 里谈论 Dukakis-Bush 选举时，随口说要送两位候选人 “to Public Access Afterworld”。
facts.anchor: three months before Davino’s on-air suicide, during one of his lesser-known rants, while he mumbled bitterly about the upcoming Dukakis-Bush election being “two sides of the same double-edged spear,” Davino made an offhand reference to wanting to send both candidates “to Public Access Afterworld.

facts.fact: Erin 坚称那是一个频道，埋在所有其他频道之下、甚至埋在雪花（static）之下。
facts.anchor: It was a channel, Erin insisted, buried under all the other channels, under even the static.

facts.fact: 周一放学后，David 在 Erin 家地下室找到了她：她坐在无窗的洞窟里，凑得离电视很近，盯着 Toshiba 上仍在播出的雪花。
facts.anchor: David found his best friend after school the following Monday just where he had left her: in her windowless, climate-controlled cave, perched a little too close to the television screen, staring at the static still broadcasting from her Toshiba.

facts.fact: David 发现 Erin 在录影——她翘课把雪花录到空白 VHS 录像带上。
facts.anchor: She was recording, David realized. She’d skipped school to record static onto VHS tapes.

facts.fact: Erin 第一次看到它是在切换夜凌晨两点到三点之间（between two and three a.m.），大约在 David 从她地下室慌张逃走一小时后，当时她正把妈妈的伏特加瓶放回酒柜。
facts.anchor: She’d first spotted it between two and three a.m. the night of the switch-off, about an hour after David’s panicked retreat from her basement, as she was putting her mom’s vodka bottle back in the liquor cabinet.

facts.fact: 雪花变成一个手绘的、逐字跳动的动画 logo，写着 “Public Access Afterworld”，像一个藏在所有旧频道之下、等待切换到来才能被发现的幽灵电视台。
facts.anchor: Soon the static formed into something unmistakable: an animated logo, hand-drawn and bouncing, letter by letter. It read “Public Access Afterworld,” like the name of a phantom TV station that had been hiding underneath all of the old channels, waiting for the switch-off so it could finally be discovered.

facts.fact: 画面变成一名女人在厨房水槽边洗碗、低声唱 “Amazing Grace”；Erin 细看后发现：两把廉价塑料刮刀其实是她身体的一部分、与她的手臂融合（fused with her arms），替代了画面中缺失的双手。
facts.anchor: The woman was singing, quietly murmuring “Amazing Grace” to herself while she washed two cheap plastic spatulas. Or…no. Erin squinted harder, trying to make out the image: The spatulas were actually part of her body, fused with her arms, replacements for the hands Erin now realized were missing from the picture.
